# Mega Pop — legal pages

Public hosting for the Mega Pop privacy policy and terms of service.

**Generated — do not edit the HTML here.** The source of truth is
`docs/legal/*.md` in the (private) `megapop` repo. To update:

```bash
# in the megapop repo
python3 scripts/build_legal_site.py     # -> build/legal-site/
# copy the generated *.html into this repo and push
```

Live at https://devmkamal.github.io/megapop-legal/

`DATA_SAFETY.md` from the source repo is deliberately NOT published — it is an
internal crib sheet for the Play Data Safety / Apple App Privacy
questionnaires, not a user-facing document.
